partnershipPlan: A carer of a former patient with dementia reviews the plain-language summary; the orthogeriatric team reviews the adjustment set.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Mum had her operation on Friday and nobody got her up until Monday; by then she was confused and frightened.
Composite paraphrase: Some patients cannot stand on day one because their pressure drops, and no amount of staffing changes that.
items.implication: Record reasons for delay and keep postoperative conditions in a sensitivity analysis.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Sitting out in a chair is not the same as standing with a frame, but the notes do not always say which.
items.implication: Use a written definition of standing or walking with a physiotherapist.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: All I wanted was to get back to my own flat, and every extra week made that less likely.
items.implication: Keep discharge destination as a secondary outcome.

summary: Four composite voices on weekend waits, clinical reasons for delay, the exposure definition and going home.
